query.description: LogsQL query expression. LogsQL is VictoriaLogs' query language. Basic syntax: (1) Simple word search: 'error' or 'timeout' (2) Time filter: '_time:5m' for last 5 minutes, '_time:1h' for last hour (3) Stream filter: '_stream:{k8s.namespace.name="default"}' or '{app="nginx"}' (4) Field search: 'log.level:error' or 'status_code:500' (5) Combined: '_time:5m _stream:{k8s.namespace.name="default"} error' (6) Exclude: '_time:5m error NOT debug' or '_time:5m error -debug' (7) Phrase search: '"connection refused"' (8) Regex: 'level:~"err.*"'

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

offset.description: Number of log entries to skip before returning results (used with limit for pagination)

start.description: Start time for the query. Accepts relative duration (e.g. '1h', '30m') or RFC3339 timestamp

end.description: End time for the query (exclusive). Accepts relative duration (e.g. 'now') or RFC3339 timestamp
